items.title: File District of Columbia County business personal property return
items.authority: District of Columbia Office of Tax and Revenue
items.description: Businesses with a location in the District file a personal property tax return (FP-31) for tangible personal property as of July 1, due July 31, electronically through MyTax.DC.gov. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.
